name: Lenny's Podcast
description: Provides searchable access to Lenny's Podcast transcripts for product management insights, using FlexSearch for fast full-text search across topics like pricing strategies, growth tactics, and product leadership advice.

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Search across all of Lenny's Podcast transcripts for insights on a topic. Returns relevant excerpts from episodes with guest names. Use this to find what product leaders and experts have said about specific topics like pricing, growth, product management, hiring, etc.

query.description: The search query - use keywords related to the topic you want insights on

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get the full transcript for a specific episode by guest name. Use this when you want to dive deeper into a specific conversation.

guest.description: The name of the guest (e.g., 'Shreyas Doshi', 'Julie Zhuo')

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List all available episodes/guests in Lenny's Podcast archive. Use this to see what guests and topics are available to search.
